healthAuthorities.name: Sundhedsdatastyrelsen (Danish Health Data Authority)
healthAuthorities.description: National agency for health data, digital health infrastructure and health registers; oversees national health-IT coordination (Medcom operates the national health data network separately).

healthAuthorities.name: Region Hovedstaden
healthAuthorities.description: Capital Region of Denmark; owns and operates public hospitals in the Copenhagen area and Bornholm. Runs Sundhedsplatformen (Epic-based EPR). Due to merge with Region Sjælland into 'Region Østdanmark' from 1 Jan 2027 under the 2024 national health reform.

healthAuthorities.name: Region Sjælland
healthAuthorities.description: Region Zealand; owns and operates public hospitals across Zealand and Lolland-Falster. Runs Sundhedsplatformen (Epic-based EPR), currently subject to political controversy including an active 2026 citizen proposal (borgerforslag) to abolish it. Due to merge with Region Hovedstaden into 'Region Østdanmark' from 1 Jan 2027.

healthAuthorities.name: Region Syddanmark
healthAuthorities.description: Region of Southern Denmark; owns and operates public hospitals across Funen and South/Southwest Jutland. Runs 'EPJ SYD', a Systematic Columna CIS-based EPR, awarded 2018 and rolled out 2021-2022 after rejecting Sundhedsplatformen/Epic in the tender.

healthAuthorities.name: Region Midtjylland
healthAuthorities.description: Central Denmark Region; owns and operates public hospitals across central Jutland. Runs 'MidtEPJ', a Systematic Columna CIS-based EPR covering the whole region since 2013 — one of Denmark's earliest and most complete single-system EPR rollouts.

healthAuthorities.name: Region Nordjylland
healthAuthorities.description: North Denmark Region; owns and operates public hospitals across North Jutland. Runs 'NordEPJ', a Systematic Columna CIS-based EPR live since March 2022. Recently consolidated most Aalborg hospital functions into the new Aalborg Universitetshospital 'Hospitalsbyen' campus (opened in phases Jan-May 2026).

hospitalGroups.name: Rigshospitalet
hospitalGroups.notes: National tertiary/university hospital with two campuses (Blegdamsvej and Glostrup).

hospitalGroups.name: Herlev og Gentofte Hospital
hospitalGroups.notes: Two-site acute/university hospital; absorbed Psykiatrisk Center Ballerup under the 1 Jan 2026 psychiatry reorganisation.

hospitalGroups.name: Bispebjerg og Frederiksberg Hospital
hospitalGroups.notes: Two-site acute hospital; absorbed Psykiatrisk Center København and Psykiatrisk Center Bornholm under the 1 Jan 2026 psychiatry reorganisation.

hospitalGroups.name: Amager og Hvidovre Hospital
hospitalGroups.notes: Two-site acute/university hospital; absorbed Psykiatrisk Center Amager, Psykiatrisk Center Glostrup and Psykiatrisk Center Sct. Hans (forensic) under the 1 Jan 2026 psychiatry reorganisation.

hospitalGroups.name: Nordsjællands Hospital
hospitalGroups.notes: Multi-site acute hospital (Hillerød main site, Frederikssund, Helsingør outpatient); absorbed Psykiatrisk Center Nordsjælland under the 1 Jan 2026 psychiatry reorganisation. New 'Nyt Hospital Nordsjælland' supersygehus under construction in Hillerød, delayed and over budget, phased opening from late 2026.

hospitalGroups.name: Bornholms Hospital
hospitalGroups.notes: Island hospital, own administrative unit reporting to Region Hovedstaden.

hospitalGroups.name: Sjællands Universitetshospital (SUH)
hospitalGroups.notes: Zealand's university hospital group, spanning Køge, Roskilde and Nykøbing F. (renamed from Nykøbing F. Sygehus, Jan-Mar 2024). New 'supersygehus' consolidation build in Køge delayed to 2028.

hospitalGroups.name: Midt- og Vestsjællands Hospital (MVH)
hospitalGroups.notes: Formed 1 January 2026 by merging Næstved, Slagelse og Ringsted Sygehuse (NSR) with Psykiatrien Region Sjælland into one combined somatic+psychiatric entity.

hospitalGroups.name: Holbæk Sygehus
hospitalGroups.notes: Remains administratively independent of SUH and MVH; covers Holbæk plus Nykøbing Sj. and Kalundborg satellite sites.

hospitalGroups.name: Epilepsihospitalet Filadelfia
hospitalGroups.notes: Self-governing (selvejende) specialist epilepsy hospital operating under a driftsoverenskomst (service contract) with Region Sjælland rather than as a directly-run regional hospital.

hospitalGroups.name: Odense Universitetshospital (OUH)
hospitalGroups.notes: Region Syddanmark's university hospital group: Odense main campus plus Svendborg, Nyborg and Ærø satellites. 'Nyt OUH' new-build supersygehus under construction adjacent to the SDU campus, repeatedly delayed (not ready for 2027 patient move-in as previously planned).

hospitalGroups.name: Sygehus Sønderjylland
hospitalGroups.notes: Covers Aabenraa, Sønderborg and Tønder; first EPJ SYD go-live site (3 Oct 2021).

hospitalGroups.name: Sygehus Lillebælt
hospitalGroups.notes: Officially a three-site entity today: Kolding, Vejle and Middelfart ('nærhospital'). Former Fredericia and Give sites have been downgraded to a sundhedshus/day clinic respectively.

hospitalGroups.name: Sydvestjysk Sygehus (SVS)
hospitalGroups.notes: Covers Esbjerg (main site) and Grindsted (day hospital); Brørup site downgraded to a hearing/radiology clinic.

hospitalGroups.name: Psykiatrien i Region Syddanmark
hospitalGroups.notes: Region-wide psychiatric hospital service, separate administrative entity from the four somatic hospital groups.

hospitalGroups.name: Aarhus Universitetshospital (AUH)
hospitalGroups.notes: Region Midtjylland's university hospital; single somatic campus at Skejby since the former Tage-Hansens Gade/Kommunehospital site closed. Psychiatry relocated to the same Skejby campus (~2019); a forensic-psychiatry inpatient expansion is under OPP construction there.

hospitalGroups.name: Regionshospitalet Randers
hospitalGroups.notes: Standalone acute/general hospital, includes co-located Regionspsykiatrien Randers.

hospitalGroups.name: Regionshospitalet Horsens
hospitalGroups.notes: Standalone acute/general hospital; official address changed from Sundvej 30 to Strandpromenaden 35 in June 2025 (same site, new Sterilcentral build). Includes co-located Regionspsykiatrien Horsens.

hospitalGroups.name: Hospitalsenhed Midt
hospitalGroups.notes: Groups Regionshospitalet Viborg, Silkeborg, Skive and Hammel Neurocenter, plus co-located psychiatry.

hospitalGroups.name: Regionshospitalet Gødstrup
hospitalGroups.notes: Renamed from Hospitalsenheden Vest in February 2022. New-build 'supersygehus' near Herning that fully absorbed the former Herning and Holstebro hospitals' inpatient/acute functions by 2021-2022; those sites are now outpatient sundhedshuse only.

hospitalGroups.name: Aalborg Universitetshospital
hospitalGroups.notes: Region Nordjylland's university hospital. New main campus 'Hospitalsbyen' (Gistrup) opened in three phases Jan-May 2026, officially inaugurated 12 May 2026; the old Aalborg Nord site (Reberbansgade) has been fully vacated and Aalborg Syd (Hobrovej) partially vacated. Psykiatrien (regional psychiatry) was merged into/equalised with AUH from 1 Jan 2026. Also administratively includes former Sygehus Thy-Mors sites (Thisted, from 1 May 2018) and former Hobro/Farsø sites (from 2014).

hospitalGroups.name: Regionshospital Nordjylland
hospitalGroups.notes: Formed 2016 from merger of Sygehus Vendsyssel and Sygehus Thy-Mors; after the Thisted/Nykøbing site moved under Aalborg UH (2018), today effectively covers the former Sygehus Vendsyssel footprint: Hjørring, Frederikshavn, Skagen and Neuroenhed Nord (Brønderslev).

hospitalGroups.name: Aleris (Aleris-Hamlet) Danmark
hospitalGroups.notes: National private hospital/clinic chain with sites across multiple regions; clinical/EPR system not publicly documented at any Danish site.

hospitalGroups.name: Capio Danmark
hospitalGroups.notes: National private hospital chain (part of Ramsay Santé group) with sites across multiple regions; clinical/EPR system not publicly documented at any Danish site.

hospitalSites.name: Rigshospitalet (Blegdamsvej)
hospitalSites.notes: Main national tertiary/university campus.

hospitalSites.name: Rigshospitalet Glostrup
hospitalSites.notes: Second Rigshospitalet campus (former Glostrup Hospital); neuro and other specialties.

hospitalSites.name: Gentofte Hospital
hospitalSites.notes: Medical/geriatric acute site.

hospitalSites.name: Frederiksberg Hospital
hospitalSites.notes: Elective/planned care site.

hospitalSites.name: Nordsjællands Hospital - Hillerød
hospitalSites.notes: Main site; new 'Nyt Hospital Nordsjælland' supersygehus under construction here, delayed to phased opening from late 2026.

hospitalSites.name: Nordsjællands Hospital - Frederikssund
hospitalSites.notes: Secondary acute site.

hospitalSites.name: Nordsjællands Hospital - Sundhedshuset Helsingør
hospitalSites.notes: Outpatient health-house, not a full inpatient hospital.

hospitalSites.name: Bornholms Hospital
hospitalSites.notes: Island hospital.

hospitalSites.name: Psykiatrisk Center Sct. Hans
hospitalSites.notes: Forensic psychiatry; physically located in Roskilde Municipality (Region Sjælland geography) but administratively part of Region Hovedstaden.

hospitalSites.name: Aleris Hospital København
hospitalSites.notes: Orthopaedic/surgical day hospital.

hospitalSites.name: Capio Privathospital Hellerup
hospitalSites.notes: Incorporates the former Capio CFR Hellerup (ex-CFR Hospitaler, acquired by Capio); orthopaedic, plastic, GI and urology.

hospitalSites.name: Sjællands Universitetshospital, Køge
hospitalSites.notes: Main SUH site; new consolidation-build supersygehus in progress, delayed to 2028.

hospitalSites.name: Sjællands Universitetshospital, Roskilde
hospitalSites.notes: Planned/elective care plus minor emergency.

hospitalSites.name: Sjællands Universitetshospital, Nykøbing F.
hospitalSites.notes: Renamed from Nykøbing F. Sygehus, Jan-Mar 2024.

hospitalSites.name: Nakskov Sundheds- og Akuthus
hospitalSites.notes: Emergency/injury clinic satellite; original full hospital closed.

hospitalSites.name: Midt- og Vestsjællands Hospital, Næstved
hospitalSites.notes: Planned/elective care plus minor emergency.

hospitalSites.name: Midt- og Vestsjællands Hospital, Ringsted
hospitalSites.notes: Diagnostic/outpatient clinic only (blood tests, EKG); original hospital building closed.

hospitalSites.name: Psykiatrien Vest, Slagelse
hospitalSites.notes: Includes forensic psychiatry and a national secure unit (Sikringsafdelingen), opened 2015.

hospitalSites.name: Psykiatrien Øst, Roskilde
hospitalSites.notes: Includes child/adolescent psychiatry.

hospitalSites.name: Nykøbing Sjælland Skadeklinik
hospitalSites.notes: Emergency/injury clinic satellite; original full hospital closed.

hospitalSites.name: Kalundborg Sundheds- og Akuthus
hospitalSites.notes: Emergency clinic plus outpatient clinics; original full hospital closed.

hospitalSites.name: Epilepsihospitalet Filadelfia
hospitalSites.notes: Self-governing specialist epilepsy/neurorehabilitation hospital under a driftsoverenskomst with Region Sjælland; EPR system not publicly confirmed (possible exception to Sundhedsplatformen default).

hospitalSites.name: Aleris Ringsted
hospitalSites.notes: Formerly Privathospitalet Valdemar.

hospitalSites.name: Roskilde Privathospital
hospitalSites.notes: Independent private hospital; plastic surgery, gynaecology, GI/urological surgery.

hospitalSites.name: Skovhus Privathospital
hospitalSites.notes: Independent private psychiatric hospital (child/adolescent/adult).

hospitalSites.name: Odense Universitetshospital (OUH)
hospitalSites.notes: Main campus; 'Nyt OUH' new-build adjacent, repeatedly delayed.

hospitalSites.name: OUH Nyborg Sygehus
hospitalSites.notes: Specialist/elective site.

hospitalSites.name: OUH Ærø Sygehus
hospitalSites.notes: Small island/local hospital.

hospitalSites.name: Sygehus Sønderjylland, Aabenraa
hospitalSites.notes: First EPJ SYD go-live site, 3 Oct 2021; includes co-located psychiatric department.

hospitalSites.name: Sygehus Sønderjylland, Tønder
hospitalSites.notes: Local/acute satellite.

hospitalSites.name: Sygehus Lillebælt, Middelfart (nærhospital)
hospitalSites.notes: Denmark's first 'nærhospital' (reduced-acuity local hospital).

hospitalSites.name: Sydvestjysk Sygehus, Esbjerg
hospitalSites.notes: Main SVS site.

hospitalSites.name: Sydvestjysk Sygehus, Grindsted
hospitalSites.notes: Day-hospital satellite.

hospitalSites.name: Dansk Gigthospital
hospitalSites.notes: Independent self-owned rheumatology specialist hospital.

hospitalSites.name: Privathospitalet Mølholm
hospitalSites.notes: Part of the Privathospitalet Danmark group; general/elective surgical hospital.

hospitalSites.name: Aarhus Universitetshospital (AUH), Skejby
hospitalSites.notes: AUH's only current somatic campus, incl. co-located psychiatry (Psykiatrien AUH).

hospitalSites.name: Regionshospitalet Randers
hospitalSites.notes: Includes co-located Regionspsykiatrien Randers.

hospitalSites.name: Regionshospitalet Horsens
hospitalSites.notes: Address changed from Sundvej 30, June 2025 (same site, new Sterilcentral build). Includes co-located Regionspsykiatrien Horsens.

hospitalSites.name: Regionshospitalet Viborg
hospitalSites.notes: Includes co-located psychiatry.

hospitalSites.name: Regionshospitalet Silkeborg
hospitalSites.notes: Acute/elective (day surgery, rheumatology); includes co-located psychiatry.

hospitalSites.name: Regionshospitalet Skive
hospitalSites.notes: Includes co-located psychiatry.

hospitalSites.name: Regionshospitalet Hammel Neurocenter
hospitalSites.notes: Highly specialised neurorehabilitation.

hospitalSites.name: Regionshospitalet Gødstrup
hospitalSites.notes: New-build 'supersygehus', phased opening 2021-2023, renamed from Hospitalsenheden Vest Feb 2022; absorbed former Herning and Holstebro inpatient functions. Includes co-located Regionspsykiatrien Gødstrup.

hospitalSites.name: Capio Viborg
hospitalSites.notes: Imaging/MR-focused.

hospitalSites.name: Aalborg Universitetshospital, Hospitalsbyen
hospitalSites.notes: New main campus; phased patient move-in Jan-May 2026, officially inaugurated 12 May 2026.

hospitalSites.name: Aalborg Universitetshospital, Syd
hospitalSites.notes: Partially vacated 2026; retains outpatient clinics, day surgery and admin functions.

hospitalSites.name: Aalborg Universitetshospital, Thisted
hospitalSites.notes: Has its own emergency reception (Akutmodtagelse); former Sygehus Thy-Mors site, under Aalborg UH since 1 May 2018.

hospitalSites.name: Aalborg Universitetshospital, Farsø
hospitalSites.notes: Elective orthopaedic surgery centre; under Aalborg UH since 2014.

hospitalSites.name: Aalborg Universitetshospital, Hobro
hospitalSites.notes: Medical department; under Aalborg UH since 2014.

hospitalSites.name: Aalborg, Havrevangen (Vejgaard)
hospitalSites.notes: Specialist outpatient: occupational/environmental medicine, functional disorders, hearing clinic.

hospitalSites.name: Aalborg Psykiatriske Sygehus (Mølleparkvej)
hospitalSites.notes: Merged into Aalborg UH from 1 Jan 2026 (formerly Psykiatrien Region Nordjylland).

hospitalSites.name: Psykiatrien, Brandevej
hospitalSites.notes: Adult inpatient psychiatry; merged into Aalborg UH from 1 Jan 2026.

hospitalSites.name: Brønderslev Psykiatriske Sygehus
hospitalSites.notes: Merged into Aalborg UH from 1 Jan 2026.

hospitalSites.name: Regionshospital Nordjylland, Frederikshavn
hospitalSites.notes: Includes co-located Neuroenhed Nord Frederikshavn.

hospitalSites.name: Skagen Gigt- og Rygcenter
hospitalSites.notes: Rheumatology/spine outpatient centre.

hospitalSites.name: Neuroenhed Nord, Brønderslev
hospitalSites.notes: Neurorehabilitation.

hospitalSites.name: Capio Privathospital Aalborg (Kennedy Arkaden)
hospitalSites.notes: Relocated from Skørping, Oct 2021.

procurementNotices.title: Syddansk patientjournal (EPJ SYD) -- EU-udbud
procurementNotices.lot_description: Region Syddanmark's region-wide EPJ replacement tender; Sundhedsplatformen/Epic was among the bidders evaluated and rejected in favour of Systematic's Columna CIS. Estimated contract value widely reported in Danish press in the DKK 1bn+ range over the contract term. Phased go-live 2021-2022.

procurementNotices.title: Ny patientjournal til de nordjyske hospitaler (NordEPJ)
procurementNotices.lot_description: Region Nordjylland's replacement EPJ project (NordEPJ), built on Systematic Columna CIS, described as the region's largest-ever IT project. Exact contract value and the specific predecessor system were not confirmed in public sources.

procurementNotices.title: Nyt Hospital Nordsjælland -- nybyggeri (supersygehus)
procurementNotices.lot_description: New-build 'supersygehus' replacing/consolidating Nordsjællands Hospital's Hillerød site. Budget has risen sharply (reported approaching/exceeding DKK 10bn) with repeated delays; latest timeline points to a phased opening from late 2026. Likely future IT/medical-equipment integration tenders as construction completes.

procurementNotices.title: Nyt OUH -- nybyggeri (supersygehus, Odense)
procurementNotices.lot_description: New-build university hospital campus adjacent to OUH/SDU in Odense. Repeatedly delayed due to contractor bankruptcies and workforce shortfalls; not ready for the previously planned 2027 patient move-in. Main contractor OHPT in renegotiation with the region over schedule and cost.

procurementNotices.title: DNV Gødstrup -- nybyggeri (supersygehus, Herning)
procurementNotices.lot_description: New-build ~127,000 sqm supersygehus near Herning (state/region quality-fund financed) that fully absorbed former Herning and Holstebro hospitals' inpatient/acute functions by 2021-2022. MidtEPJ carried over without a system change.

procurementNotices.title: Borgerforslag: afskaffelse af Sundhedsplatformen
procurementNotices.lot_description: Active citizen proposal (borgerforslag) calling for Sundhedsplatformen to be phased out across Region Hovedstaden and Region Sjælland in favour of a unified national EPJ, citing cost, inefficiency and data-sovereignty concerns (Epic being a US company). Had 4,097 signatures as of 7 April 2026; proposal window runs to 1 September 2026. Roughly half of candidates in the Nov 2025 Region Østdanmark council election favoured replacing Sundhedsplatformen. Not a formal procurement action, but a significant market-disruption signal for the Epic/Sundhedsplatformen incumbency in eastern Denmark.
